body.statement: For either support rule \(s\), every optimizer of \texttt{def:bonferroni-socp} yields the rectangular band \(\widehat\tau_e(w)\pm[b_e(w)+z_B\operatorname{sd}_e(w)]\), \(e\in\mathcal E\), with finite-sample coverage at least \(1-\alpha\) uniformly over \(P\in\mathcal M_{N,T,K,p}\). The optimization has the rational standard-form SOCP encoding in \texttt{def:standard-conic-encoding}, and its optimal maximum half-width is \(\Gamma_s\).
body.justification: The theorem supplies an implementable, outcome-independent weight rule with exact finite-sample honesty and auditable finite input.
body.gap: CattaneoFengPalombaTitiunik2025 gives non-asymptotic staggered prediction intervals and conic computation, but does not choose horizon-specific weights to minimize a common honest bias-plus-standard-error envelope.
body.consumer: The rational SOCP can be added as a width-optimal weighting option to \texttt{scpi} and \texttt{augsynth::multisynth}.
